name: Scooby-Doo

specialAbility.name: Scooby Snack
specialAbility.description: Scooby scarfs down a magical Scooby Snack and gets a burst of bravery that heals the truck right up!

lore: Zoinks! The Mystery Machine got a mega monster truck makeover! Scooby-Doo rolls into the arena with bright green splatter paint and a wagging tail antenna. It might look a little scared at first, but toss it a Scooby Snack and watch it go full beast mode. Mystery solved: this truck rules!
